Diversity Policy is set out below:


Purpose:                                The Board Diversity Policy aims to set out the approach to achieve diversity of the
                                        Board and enable the Board to comply with the Corporate Governance Code.
目的：                                     董事會成員多元化政策旨在訂明實現董事會成員多元化的方法，及使董事會遵守
                                        企業管治守則。


Statement:                              The Company considers increasing diversity at the Board level as an essential
                                        element in supporting the attainment of its strategic objectives and its sustainable
                                        development. In designing the Board’s composition, the Board diversity has been
                                        considered from a number of aspects, including but not limited to gender, age,
                                        cultural and educational background, race, nationality, sexual orientation, professional
                                        experience, skills, knowledge and length of service. All Board appointments will be
                                        based on meritocracy, and candidates will be considered against objective criteria,
                                        having due regard for the benefits of diversity on the Board.
聲明：                                     本公司視董事會層面的日益多元化為支持其達到策略目標及可持續發展的必要元
                                        素。於設計董事會之組成時，本公司已從多方面考慮董事會成員多元化，包括但
                                        不限於性別、年齡、文化及教育背景、種族、國籍、性取向、專業經驗、技能、
                                        知識以及服務年期。所有董事會成員之任命將按用人唯才而定，而候選人將按照
                                        客觀準則，並適當顧及董事會成員多元化的裨益予以考慮。

8. SHARE-BASED COMPENSATION EXPENSES                                           8. 以股份為基礎的酬金開支
  In March 2022, the Company adopted a 2022 RSU plan (the “2022 RSU               於二零二二年三月，本公司採納二零二二
  Plan”), which allows officers, employees, non-employees and directors           年受限制股份單位計劃（「二零二二年受限
  of the Company to receive RSU awards under the 2022 RSU Plan. The               制股份單位計劃」），該計劃允許本公司高
  maximum number of ordinary shares that may be subject to the awards             級職員、僱員、非僱員及董事根據二零二
  granted under the 2022 RSU Plan is 55,459,938 shares.                           二年受限制股份單位計劃獲得受限制股份
                                                                                  單位獎勵。根據二零二二年受限制股份單

  are used for economic hedging purposes (instead of being speculative               用作經濟對沖用途（而非投機性投資）的衍
  investments) to manage the Group’s foreign exchange risk. However,                 生工具合約以管理本集團的外匯風險。然
  these derivative contracts do not meet the hedge accounting criteria               而，該等衍生工具合約不符合對沖會計準
  and hence they are classified as “held for trading” for accounting                 則，因此就會計目的而言彼等被分類為「持
  purposes and are accounted for as financial assets/(liabilities) at fair           作買賣」並入賬列作按公允價值計量且其變
  value through profit or loss.                                                      動計入損益的金融資產 ╱（負債）。


  The full fair value of hedging derivatives is classified as a non-current          當對沖項目的剩餘到期日超過 12 個月時，
  asset or liability when the remaining maturity of the hedged item is               對沖衍生工具的全部公允價值被分類為非
  more than 12 months. It is classified as a current asset or liability when         流動資產或負債。當對沖項目的剩餘到期
  the remaining maturity of the hedged item is less than 12 months.                  日少於 12 個月時，其被分類為流動資產或
  Trading derivatives are classified as a current asset or liability.                負債。交易衍生工具被分類為流動資產或

  occurring is insignificant.

  one year or less. If not, they are presented as non-current liabilities.        付，則分類為流動負債，否則呈列為非流動負
                                                                                  債。

      41 SUMMARY OF OTHER ACCOUNTING POLICIES                                         41 其他會計政策概要
          This note provides a list of other accounting policies adopted in the        本附註載列編製該等綜合財務報表時所採
          preparation of these consolidated financial statements. These policies       用的其他會計政策。除另有說明者外，該
          have been consistently applied to all the years presented, unless            等政策於呈列的各個年度內貫徹應用。綜
          otherwise stated. The consolidated financial statements are for the          合財務報表乃就本集團（包括本公司及其附
          Group consisting of Company and its subsidiaries.                            屬公司）編製。


          41.1 Subsidiaries                                                            41.1 附屬公司
              (a) Consolidation                                                          (a) 綜合入賬

                   A subsidiary is an entity (including a structured entity) over           附屬公司指本集團擁有控制權的實
                   which the Group has control. The Group controls an entity                體（包括結構性實體）。倘本集團
                   when the Group is exposed to, or has rights to, variable                 就參與實體所得可變回報承擔風險
                   returns from its involvement with the entity and has the ability         或享有權利，並能透過其對該實體
                   to affect those returns through its power over the entity.               的權力影響該等回報，則本集團對
                   Subsidiaries are fully consolidated from the date on which               該實體有控制權。附屬公司自控制
                   control is transferred to the Group. They are deconsolidated             權轉移至本集團之日起開始全數綜
                   from the date when control ceases.                                       合入賬。彼等自控制權喪失之日起
                                                                                            終止綜合入賬。


                   Intra-group transactions, balances and unrealized gains                  集團內公司間的交易、結餘及交易
                   on transactions between group companies are eliminated.                  的未變現收益予以抵銷。除非交易
                   Unrealized losses are also eliminated unless the transaction             有證據顯示所轉讓資產出現減值，
                   provides evidence of an impairment of the asset transferred.             否則未變現虧損亦予以抵銷。於必
                   When necessary, amounts reported by subsidiaries have been               要時，將會對附屬公司呈報之金額
                   adjusted to conform with the Group’s accounting policies.                作出調整，以與本集團之會計政策
                                                                                            一致。

         amount is increased or decreased to recognize the investor’s                  面值以確認於收購日期後投資者在
         share of the profit or loss and share of movements in other                   被投資公司的應佔損益及應佔其他
         comprehensive income of the investee after the date of                        全面收益變動。從聯營公司已收取
         acquisition. Dividends received or receivable from associates                 或應收取股息確認為投資賬面金額
         are recognized as a reduction in the carrying amount of the                   的削減。本集團於該等聯營公司的
         investment. The Group’s investments in these associates                       投資包括收購時識別的商譽，經扣
         include goodwill identified on acquisition, net of any                        除任何累計減值虧損。收購一間聯
         accumulated impairment loss. Upon the acquisition of the                      營公司擁有權權益後，該聯營公司
         ownership interest in an associate, any difference between the                的成本與本集團所佔聯營公司可識
         cost of the associate and the Group’s share of the net fair value             別資產及負債公允價值淨額之間的
         of the associate’s identifiable assets and liabilities is accounted           差額作為商譽入賬並計入投資的賬
         for as goodwill and included as part of the carrying amount of                面值的一部分。
         the investments.


         If the ownership interest in an associate in the form of ordinary             倘以普通股形式於聯營公司的擁有
         shares is reduced but significant influence is retained, only a               權權益減少但仍保留重大影響力，
         proportionate share of the amounts previously recognized in                   則僅會將先前按比例在其他全面收

     period.

          41.13 Provisions                                                               41.13 撥備
              Provisions are recognized when the Group has a present legal or               倘本集團因過往事件而具有現時法定
              constructive obligation as a result of past events; it is probable that       或推定責任，而履行該等責任可能需
              an outflow of resources will be required to settle the obligation;            要資源流出，且所涉及的金額能可靠
              and the amount has been reliably estimated. Provisions are not                地估計，則會確認撥備。未來經營虧
              recognized for further operating losses.                                      損毋須確認撥備。


              Where there are a number of similar obligations, the likelihood               如有多項類似責任，則在償付時所需
              that an outflow will be required in settlement is determined by               的流出的可能性乃根據責任類別的整
              considering the class of obligations as a whole. A provision is               體考慮而釐定。即使在同一責任類別
              recognized even if the likelihood of an outflow with respect to any           所包含的任何一個項目相關的資源流
              one item included in the same class of obligations may be small.              出的可能性極低，仍須確認撥備。


              Provisions are measured at the present value of the management’s              撥備採用反映當時市場對金錢時間值
              best estimate of the expenditures expected to be required to settle           及責任特定風險之評估之稅前比率，
              the obligation using a pre-tax rate that reflects current market              按照管理層對預期履行責任所需支出
              assessments of the time value of money and the risks specific to the          之最佳估計之現值計量。隨著時間流
              obligation. The increase in the provision due to passage of time is           逝而增加之撥備確認為利息開支。
              recognized as interest expense.


          41.14 Interest income                                                          41.14利息收入
              Interest income is calculated by applying the effective interest rate         利息收入乃通過應用實際利率於金融
              to the gross carrying amount of a financial asset except for financial        資產賬面總值來計算，惟後續發生信
              assets that subsequently become credit-impaired. For credit-                  貸減值的金融資產除外。就發生信貸
              impaired financial assets the effective interest rate is applied to the       減值的金融資產而言，則應用實際利
              net carrying amount of the financial asset (after deduction of the            率於金融資產的賬面淨值（扣除虧損撥
              loss allowance).                                                              備後）。
